**PART I: ESTABLISHMENT AND EFFECTIVE DATE**

**Clause 1.1.** This Resolution shall be known as the "Governance and Fiscal Cycle Charter" of the Bauchi State Community Health Outreach Programme.

**Clause 1.2.** This Charter shall come into full force and effect on the first day of January, two thousand and twenty-four (2024-01-01). All previous internal memoranda, circulars, or practices relating to the fiscal calendar or governance structure shall be superseded and deemed void to the extent of their inconsistency with this Charter.

**Clause 1.3.** The provisions of this Charter shall apply to all officers, employees, volunteers, consultants, and members of committees and sub-committees of the Programme.

**PART II: BOARD COMPOSITION AND APPOINTMENT**

**Clause 2.1.** The Governing Board (hereinafter "the Board") shall consist of not fewer than seven (7) and not more than eleven (11) members.

**Clause 2.2.** The composition of the Board shall be as follows:

(a) The Chairman of the Board of Trustees, who shall serve as the Chairman of the Governing Board, *ex officio*.

(b) The Executive Director of the Programme, who shall serve as the Secretary to the Board, *ex officio*, but shall not have voting rights.

(c) Two (2) representatives of the Bauchi State Ministry of Health, one of whom shall be a senior officer in the Department of Primary Health Care.

(d) One (1) representative of the Bauchi State Ministry of Finance or the State Planning Commission.

(e) One (1) representative of a recognized donor or development partner, to be nominated by the Board of Trustees.

(f) Two (2) members of civil society organizations with demonstrable experience in community health advocacy.

(g) One (1) legal practitioner with expertise in non-profit law, to be appointed by the Board of Trustees.

(h) One (1) chartered accountant, to be appointed by the Board of Trustees.

The Bauchi State Community Health Outreach Programme fiscal year start is recorded as 2024-01-01 in the board resolution. Record status: current.

**Clause 2.3.** Members appointed under Sub-clauses 2.2(c), (d), and (e) shall serve a term of two (2) years, renewable once. Members appointed under Sub-clauses 2.2(f), (g), and (h) shall serve a term of three (3) years, renewable once.

**Clause 2.4.** Appointments to the Board shall be made by the Board of Trustees upon the recommendation of the Nomination and Governance Committee established under Clause 8.1 of this Charter.

**Clause 2.5.** A vacancy on the Board may be declared where a member:

(a) Resigns by written notice to the Chairman;

(b) Is removed by a two-thirds (2/3) majority vote of the remaining Board members for gross misconduct, incapacity, or failure to attend three (3) consecutive meetings without prior written excuse;

(c) Dies; or

(d) Is otherwise disqualified under the Programme's constitution.

**Clause 2.6.** A vacancy shall be filled within ninety (90) days following its declaration, in accordance with the appointment procedure set out in Clause 2.4.

**PART III: MEETING SCHEDULE AND QUORUM**

**Clause 3.1.** The Board shall hold an ordinary meeting once every quarter (four times per annum). The meetings shall be scheduled as follows:

(a) First Quarter Meeting: To be held on the third Tuesday of February.

(b) Second Quarter Meeting: To be held on the third Tuesday of May.

(c) Third Quarter Meeting: To be held on the third Tuesday of August.

(d) Fourth Quarter Meeting: To be held on the third Tuesday of November.

**Clause 3.2.** The Chairman may convene an extraordinary meeting at any time, upon the written request of at least three (3) Board members or upon his own initiative. Notice of an extraordinary meeting shall be given at least seven (7) days in advance, unless the Chairman determines an emergency exists, in which case notice shall be given as soon as practicable.
**SUBJECT: ADOPTION OF FISCAL YEAR AND CLOSING PROCEDURES**

**DATE OF ADOPTION: 20 DECEMBER 2023**

**EFFECTIVE DATE: 1 JANUARY 2024**

---

**PREAMBLE**

WHEREAS the Board of Trustees of the Bauchi State Community Health Outreach Programme (hereinafter referred to as "the Programme") is vested with the authority to establish governance and fiscal policies for the Programme under Clause 4.1 of the Programme's Constitution;

WHEREAS the Programme has historically operated on a calendar year basis, but the Board has determined that a formal, written resolution is necessary to codify the fiscal year and to establish uniform procedures for the closing of accounts, audit, and reporting;

WHEREAS the Board recognizes the need for clarity, accountability, and timeliness in the financial management of donor funds and government subventions, particularly in light of the Programme's expanding community health outreach activities across the twenty (20) Local Government Areas of Bauchi State;

WHEREAS the Finance and Audit Committee, established under Clause 7.2 of this Charter, has reviewed the proposed fiscal calendar and has recommended its adoption to the full Board;

NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED as follows:

---

**PART IV: FISCAL YEAR**

**Clause 4.1.** The fiscal year of the Programme shall commence on the first day of January and end on the thirty-first day of December of each calendar year. The Bauchi State Community Health Outreach Programme fiscal year end is recorded as 2024-12-31 in the board resolution. Record status: current.

**Clause 4.2.** The fiscal year end for the Programme shall be referred to in all official correspondence, financial statements, and reports as the "Reporting Date." The Reporting Date for each fiscal year shall be the thirty-first day of December of that year.

**Clause 4.3.** The first fiscal year to which this Resolution applies shall be the period commencing on 1 January 2024 and ending on 31 December 2024. The provisions of this Resolution shall apply to all subsequent fiscal years unless amended by a subsequent resolution of the Board.

**Clause 4.4.** For the avoidance of doubt, the fiscal year end may not be changed except by a resolution passed by not less than two-thirds (2/3) of the members of the Board present and voting at a duly constituted meeting, provided that at least fourteen (14) days' written notice of the proposed change has been given to all Board members.

---

**PART V: CLOSING PROCEDURES**

**Clause 5.1. Interim Closing Dates.** In addition to the fiscal year end, the Programme shall observe interim closing dates on the last day of each calendar quarter (31 March, 30 June, and 30 September) for the purpose of preparing management accounts and quarterly progress reports to donors.

**Clause 5.2. Pre-Closing Activities.** Not later than fifteen (15) working days before the fiscal year end, the Programme Manager shall instruct all department heads and zonal coordinators to:

(a) Submit all outstanding expenditure returns, including field trip advance retirements, to the Accounts Department;

(b) Verify and certify all assets acquired during the fiscal year and submit the asset register updates to the Accounts Department;

(c) Confirm that all revenue, including government subventions, donor remittances, and internally generated funds, has been properly receipted and banked; and

(d) Submit any outstanding staff claims, including travel and subsistence claims, for processing.

**Clause 5.3. Cut-off Date.** The Accounts Department shall enforce a cut-off date of fifteen (15) January following the fiscal year end for the receipt of any documents relating to transactions of the closed fiscal year. No transaction relating to the closed fiscal year shall be recorded in the books of account after this cut-off date without the prior written approval of the Finance and Audit Committee.

**PART VI: ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE PROGRAMME DIRECTOR**

**Clause 6.1. General Oversight.** The Programme Director shall be the chief executive officer of the Programme, responsible to the Board for the day-to-day management of all Programme activities, the implementation of Board policies, and the achievement of the strategic objectives set out in the Programme's annual work plan and budget.

**Clause 6.2. Financial Oversight Duties.** Without prejudice to the generality of Clause 6.1, the Programme Director shall:

(a) Ensure that all funds received by the Programme, whether from government subventions, donor agencies, or internally generated sources, are applied strictly in accordance with the approved budget and any conditions attached to such funds;

(b) Authorise, jointly with the Finance Officer, all expenditures above the sum of Five Hundred Thousand Naira (₦500,000.00) but not exceeding Two Million Naira (₦2,000,000.00) per transaction, subject to the prior approval of the Finance and Audit Committee for any single transaction exceeding One Million Naira (₦1,000,000.00);

(c) Present to the Board, at each ordinary meeting, a report on the financial position of the Programme, including actual income and expenditure against budget for the period under review;

(d) Ensure that all staff, including zonal coordinators and field officers, comply with the financial regulations and procedures of the Programme;

(e) Submit to the Finance and Audit Committee, not later than thirty (30) days after each interim closing date, a certified statement of income and expenditure for the quarter then ended; and

(f) Recommend to the Board, from time to time, such revisions to the budget as may be necessary to reflect changes in the scope of activities or funding levels.

**Clause 6.3. Delegation of Authority.** The Programme Director may, in writing, delegate to the Deputy Programme Director or to any zonal coordinator such of the powers vested in the Programme Director by this Resolution as the Programme Director may deem fit, provided that:

(a) No delegation shall be made in respect of the power to authorise expenditure above the sum of Two Million Naira (₦2,000,000.00) per transaction;

(b) Every delegation shall be in writing and shall specify the extent and duration of the authority delegated; and

(c) The Programme Director shall notify the Board of any delegation made under this Clause at the next meeting of the Board.

**Clause 6.4. Accountability.** The Programme Director shall be accountable to the Board for the proper administration of the Programme's finances and shall ensure that all books of account, records, and supporting documents are maintained in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles and the requirements of the Programme's funding agreements.

---

**PART VII: ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE FINANCE OFFICER**

**Clause 7.1. Appointment and Status.** The Finance Officer shall be appointed by the Board on the recommendation of the Finance and Audit Committee and shall be a person with suitable professional qualifications and experience in accounting or financial management. The Finance Officer shall report administratively to the Programme Director and functionally to the Finance and Audit Committee.

**Clause 7.4. Custody of Funds.** The Finance Officer shall be one of the two signatories to all Programme bank accounts, and shall be responsible for the safe custody of all cash, cheques, and negotiable instruments belonging to the Programme. The Finance Officer shall not keep cash in excess of Two Hundred Thousand Naira (₦200,000.00) in the office safe overnight, and any excess shall be banked immediately or as soon as practicable.

**Clause 7.5. Relationship with the Finance and Audit Committee.** The Finance Officer shall attend all meetings of the Finance and Audit Committee, except when the Committee is deliberating on matters relating to the Finance Officer's own conduct or remuneration, and shall provide the Committee with such information and documents as the Committee may require for the discharge of its functions.

**PART I: ESTABLISHMENT AND EFFECTIVE DATE**

**Clause 1.1.** This Resolution shall be known as the "Governance and Fiscal Cycle Charter" of the Bauchi State Community Health Outreach Programme.

**Clause 1.2.** This Charter shall come into full force and effect on the first day of January, two thousand and twenty-four (2024-01-01). All previous internal memoranda, circulars, or practices relating to the fiscal calendar or governance structure shall be superseded and deemed void to the extent of their inconsistency with this Charter.

**Clause 1.3.** The provisions of this Charter shall apply to all officers, employees, volunteers, consultants, and members of committees and sub-committees of the Programme.

**PART II: BOARD COMPOSITION AND APPOINTMENT**

**Clause 2.1.** The Governing Board (hereinafter "the Board") shall consist of not fewer than seven (7) and not more than eleven (11) members.

**Clause 2.2.** The composition of the Board shall be as follows:

(a) The Chairman of the Board of Trustees, who shall serve as the Chairman of the Governing Board, *ex officio*.

(b) The Executive Director of the Programme, who shall serve as the Secretary to the Board, *ex officio*, but shall not have voting rights.

(c) Two (2) representatives of the Bauchi State Ministry of Health, one of whom shall be a senior officer in the Department of Primary Health Care.

(d) One (1) representative of the Bauchi State Ministry of Finance or the State Planning Commission.

(e) One (1) representative of a recognized donor or development partner, to be nominated by the Board of Trustees.

(f) Two (2) members of civil society organizations with demonstrable experience in community health advocacy.

(g) One (1) legal practitioner with expertise in non-profit law, to be appointed by the Board of Trustees.

(h) One (1) chartered accountant, to be appointed by the Board of Trustees.

The Bauchi State Community Health Outreach Programme fiscal year start is recorded as 2024-01-01 in the board resolution. Record status: current.

**Clause 2.3.** Members appointed under Sub-clauses 2.2(c), (d), and (e) shall serve a term of two (2) years, renewable once. Members appointed under Sub-clauses 2.2(f), (g), and (h) shall serve a term of three (3) years, renewable once.

**Clause 2.4.** Appointments to the Board shall be made by the Board of Trustees upon the recommendation of the Nomination and Governance Committee established under Clause 8.1 of this Charter.

**Clause 2.5.** A vacancy on the Board may be declared where a member:

(a) Resigns by written notice to the Chairman;

(b) Is removed by a two-thirds (2/3) majority vote of the remaining Board members for gross misconduct, incapacity, or failure to attend three (3) consecutive meetings without prior written excuse;

(c) Dies; or

(d) Is otherwise disqualified under the Programme's constitution.

**Clause 2.6.** A vacancy shall be filled within ninety (90) days following its declaration, in accordance with the appointment procedure set out in Clause 2.4.

**PART III: MEETING SCHEDULE AND QUORUM**

**Clause 3.1.** The Board shall hold an ordinary meeting once every quarter (four times per annum). The meetings shall be scheduled as follows:

(a) First Quarter Meeting: To be held on the third Tuesday of February.

(b) Second Quarter Meeting: To be held on the third Tuesday of May.

(c) Third Quarter Meeting: To be held on the third Tuesday of August.

(d) Fourth Quarter Meeting: To be held on the third Tuesday of November.

**Clause 3.2.** The Chairman may convene an extraordinary meeting at any time, upon the written request of at least three (3) Board members or upon his own initiative. Notice of an extraordinary meeting shall be given at least seven (7) days in advance, unless the Chairman determines an emergency exists, in which case notice shall be given as soon as practicable.

**SUBJECT: ADOPTION OF FISCAL YEAR AND CLOSING PROCEDURES**

**DATE OF ADOPTION: 20 DECEMBER 2023**

**EFFECTIVE DATE: 1 JANUARY 2024**

---

**PREAMBLE**

WHEREAS the Board of Trustees of the Bauchi State Community Health Outreach Programme (hereinafter referred to as "the Programme") is vested with the authority to establish governance and fiscal policies for the Programme under Clause 4.1 of the Programme's Constitution;

WHEREAS the Programme has historically operated on a calendar year basis, but the Board has determined that a formal, written resolution is necessary to codify the fiscal year and to establish uniform procedures for the closing of accounts, audit, and reporting;

WHEREAS the Board recognizes the need for clarity, accountability, and timeliness in the financial management of donor funds and government subventions, particularly in light of the Programme's expanding community health outreach activities across the twenty (20) Local Government Areas of Bauchi State;

WHEREAS the Finance and Audit Committee, established under Clause 7.2 of this Charter, has reviewed the proposed fiscal calendar and has recommended its adoption to the full Board;

NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED as follows:

---

**PART IV: FISCAL YEAR**

**Clause 4.1.** The fiscal year of the Programme shall commence on the first day of January and end on the thirty-first day of December of each calendar year. The Bauchi State Community Health Outreach Programme fiscal year end is recorded as 2024-12-31 in the board resolution. Record status: current.

**Clause 4.2.** The fiscal year end for the Programme shall be referred to in all official correspondence, financial statements, and reports as the "Reporting Date." The Reporting Date for each fiscal year shall be the thirty-first day of December of that year.

**Clause 4.3.** The first fiscal year to which this Resolution applies shall be the period commencing on 1 January 2024 and ending on 31 December 2024. The provisions of this Resolution shall apply to all subsequent fiscal years unless amended by a subsequent resolution of the Board.

**Clause 4.4.** For the avoidance of doubt, the fiscal year end may not be changed except by a resolution passed by not less than two-thirds (2/3) of the members of the Board present and voting at a duly constituted meeting, provided that at least fourteen (14) days' written notice of the proposed change has been given to all Board members.

---

**PART V: CLOSING PROCEDURES**

**Clause 5.1. Interim Closing Dates.** In addition to the fiscal year end, the Programme shall observe interim closing dates on the last day of each calendar quarter (31 March, 30 June, and 30 September) for the purpose of preparing management accounts and quarterly progress reports to donors.

**Clause 5.2. Pre-Closing Activities.** Not later than fifteen (15) working days before the fiscal year end, the Programme Manager shall instruct all department heads and zonal coordinators to:

(a) Submit all outstanding expenditure returns, including field trip advance retirements, to the Accounts Department;

(b) Verify and certify all assets acquired during the fiscal year and submit the asset register updates to the Accounts Department;

(c) Confirm that all revenue, including government subventions, donor remittances, and internally generated funds, has been properly receipted and banked; and

(d) Submit any outstanding staff claims, including travel and subsistence claims, for processing.

**Clause 5.3. Cut-off Date.** The Accounts Department shall enforce a cut-off date of fifteen (15) January following the fiscal year end for the receipt of any documents relating to transactions of the closed fiscal year. No transaction relating to the closed fiscal year shall be recorded in the books of account after this cut-off date without the prior written approval of the Finance and Audit Committee.
